findings: mixed egress semantics in legacy plan
interface endpoint policy used wildcard principal
subnet flow logs missing or not keyed per tier and AZ
flow-log IAM policy used global wildcard resources
runtime queue policy lacked TLS and VPC-endpoint deny controls
required_remediation: no default internet routes on data subnets
scoped PrivateLink and interface endpoint policies
gateway endpoints attached only to app and data route tables
subnet-level flow logs with interface-id log format and scoped delivery IAM
resolver security limited to corporate DNS CIDRs on TCP/UDP 53
KMS and SQS runtime policies without wildcard grants and with explicit deny fencing
